intended_use: semantic conformance fixtures for connecting the threat portfolio to existing service, robustness, recovery, measurement and VOI owners; not real-world forecasts or measured protection outcomes

cases.description: A fictional small water utility experiences a bounded electricity and communications service interruption. The fixture tests the mapping from a declared disruption to service continuity and verified restoration evidence.
expected_invariants: A backup is not credited as effective merely because a backup artifact or product exists.
Restoration evidence must bind to the exact configuration and be exercised or otherwise independently validated.
Service and buffer recovery remain separate outputs.
No numeric event probability or expected annualized loss is produced.
No portfolio ranking is emitted until matched service, lifecycle and provenance receipts exist.

cases.description: Two candidate policies restore the declared service floor, but one does so while exhausting the reserve required for continued operation.
expected_invariants: Service restoration is reported as achieved for its declared scope.
Whole-system recovery is not reported as achieved.
Reserve depletion remains visible in native units and is not hidden by the service result.
A second portfolio that preserves both service and reserves is not declared equivalent merely because both cross the service floor.

cases.description: One resilient power and communications capability supports several hazard families and services. The same avoided service deficit is referenced by multiple hazard claims.
expected_invariants: A shared capability may be linked to multiple hazard families.
The same beneficiary/service/time benefit is credited once in the portfolio economics.
A joint portfolio result supersedes the sum of overlapping isolated claims.
The bridge abstains until overlapping claims are reconciled.

cases.description: An additional measurement narrows epistemic uncertainty but leaves the feasible set and chosen portfolio unchanged.
expected_invariants: The observation may receive information-quality credit.
No avoided service deficit or physical protection benefit is attributed to a measurement that did not change the intervention or outcome.
The fully burdened observation cost remains in lifecycle economics.
The VOI owner, not this bridge, computes decision value.

cases.description: A candidate has lower lifecycle cost and improved non-safety performance but violates a mandatory human-safety or egress requirement.
expected_invariants: The candidate is excluded from the feasible portfolio set.
Cost, service availability or other objective gains cannot compensate for the violated mandatory floor.
The rejected candidate remains visible in the report with its reason.
A safer alternative or abstention is required.

cases.description: The event mechanism is discussed but the event frequency and local exposure are not supported by an admitted source.
expected_invariants: No numeric probability, expected annualized loss or probability-derived cost-benefit ratio is emitted.
Evidence maturity, actual exposure and consequence uncertainty remain separate.
Low-cost general preparedness may be evaluated without asserting an event probability.
A speculative physical pathway is not converted into a funded specialized requirement.
